remarks: Welcome to 36 Holcomb Avenue. Spacious colonial filled with character and light and has the space, layout and features you want for how we live today. Beautifully updated eat-in-kitchen boasts new quartz counters, stainless appliances and tile floor. Generous sized dining room to host all of your holidays leads to large living room with fireplace and built-ins. Need to work from home? Right off the living room is an additonal room that can accomodate your remote work needs. Upstairs are 3 bedrooms and a gorgeous, renovated full bath. Entire interior freshly painted, and gleaming hardwood floors refinished. You will love the sunporch right off the kitchen for added space. One car detached garage adds to the perfection. Walk to everything downtown Stamford has to offer-shopping, entertainment, restaurants, and so much more. Make your home ownership dreams a reality. Simply unpack and move right in! House being sold "AS IS". Highest and Best tomorrow 10/8 at 2pm. Seller prefers offers to be submitted on Purchase Agreement and not Standard Form Real Estate contract.
